title: Perspective review: where analytics should execute
reviewedVersion: Default-branch source snapshot (master); not a release review
method: Read-only GitHub API metadata, pinned tree and selected source inspection. Full selected-file Git blob SHA-1 verified before excerpt retention. No upstream code executed.
scope: Curated source identifiers and claim ledger only; no raw API responses, full source excerpts, runtime results or exhaustive security audit.

treeScope.limitation: Tree retrieval complete; only listed sources substantively reviewed, not an exhaustive code audit.

chartInventory.title: Perspective — selected source-file map
chartInventory.method: Count Git tree blob entries under each exact directory prefix matching its include regex and not its exclude regex. Count paths, not lines, test cases, integrations, installed services, coverage, runtime size or performance. Matching tests, declarations and generated files are included unless excluded explicitly. Git submodules are not expanded. Only listed roots are counted; the selection is not a repository-wide denominator.
chartInventory.limitation: Static inventory only; the contents of every counted file were not reviewed. Counts must not be compared as product quality, security, speed or maintenance-effort scores.

claim.claim: The source-map values count the retained matching Git blob paths for the selected roots at this commit.
claim.evidenceType: direct Git tree inventory; reviewer-selected grouping
claim.locator: groups[].source identifies the tree; groups[].prefix/includePattern/excludePattern define selection; groups[].files lists every counted path and blob ID.
claim.limitation: Tree entry counts do not verify behavior or quality. Content review remains limited to the original cited excerpts.
